segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בָּצֵק הַחֵרֵשׁ, אִם יֵשׁ כַּיּוֹצֵא בּוֹ שֶׁהֶחְמִיץ — הֲרֵי זֶה אָסוּר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Deaf dough» is dough for which it is difficult to determine if it has been leavened. It is comparable to a deaf-mute, who cannot communicate. «If there is» dough «similar to it» in that water was added to both at the same time, «which became leavened,» the deaf dough «is prohibited.» Although it has not shown external signs of becoming leavened, it can be presumed that the deaf dough has also become leavened.

moves.summary: deaf dough is prohibited if a comparable dough leavened

positions.claim: deaf dough is prohibited if similar dough prepared with it has leavened
